mapper.sql: run.id AS run_id, run.rule_release_id, release.release_code AS rule_release_code, run.rule_snapshot_hash, run.run_status_code, run.provider_code, run.collected_from, run.collected_to, run.include_linked_announcements, run.maximum_count, run.batch_size, run.total_count, coalesce(counts.pending_count, 0)::integer AS pending_count, coalesce(counts.previewed_count, 0)::integer AS previewed_count, coalesce(counts.accepted_count, 0)::integer AS accepted_count, coalesce(counts.review_required_count, 0)::integer AS review_required_count, coalesce(counts.excluded_count, 0)::integer AS excluded_count, coalesce(counts.applied_count, 0)::integer AS applied_count, coalesce(counts.conflict_count, 0)::integer AS conflict_count, coalesce(counts.failed_count, 0)::integer AS failed_count, coalesce(counts.rolled_back_count, 0)::integer AS rolled_back_count, run.requested_by, run.row_version, run.created_at, run.updated_at, run.preview_completed_at, run.application_completed_at, run.rollback_completed_at

INNER JOIN announcement_source_classification_rule_releases release ON release.id = run.rule_release_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(1) FILTER (WHERE item.item_status_code = 'PENDING') AS pending_count, count(1) FILTER (WHERE item.item_status_code = 'PREVIEWED') AS previewed_count, count(1) FILTER (WHERE item.predicted_semantic_status_code = 'ACCEPTED') AS accepted_count, count(1) FILTER (WHERE item.predicted_semantic_status_code = 'REVIEW_REQUIRED') AS review_required_count, count(1) FILTER (WHERE item.predicted_semantic_status_code = 'EXCLUDED') AS excluded_count, count(1) FILTER (WHERE item.item_status_code = 'APPLIED') AS applied_count, count(1) FILTER (WHERE item.item_status_code IN ( 'PREVIEW_CONFLICT', 'APPLY_CONFLICT', 'ROLLBACK_CONFLICT' )) AS conflict_count, count(1) FILTER (WHERE item.item_status_code IN ( 'PREVIEW_FAILED', 'APPLY_FAILED', 'ROLLBACK_FAILED' )) AS failed_count, count(1) FILTER (WHERE item.item_status_code = 'ROLLED_BACK') AS rolled_back_count FROM announcement_source_reclassification_run_items item WHERE item.run_id = run.id ) counts ON TRUE
mapper.insert: -- Create an immutable production reclassification scope against the current ACTIVE release. INSERT INTO announcement_source_reclassification_runs ( id, rule_release_id, rule_snapshot_hash, provider_code, collected_from, collected_to, include_linked_announcements, maximum_count, batch_size, request_reason_hash, requested_by ) SELECT #{runId}, release.id, release.rule_snapshot_hash, #{providerCode}, #{collectedFrom}, #{collectedTo}, #{includeLinkedAnnouncements}, #{maximumCount}, #{batchSize}, #{requestReasonHash}, #{requestedBy} FROM announcement_source_classification_rule_releases release WHERE release.id = #{ruleReleaseId} AND release.release_status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND release.rule_snapshot_hash IS NOT NULL

-- Freeze the selected production source and content versions before running the preview. WITH run_scope AS ( SELECT run.id, run.provider_code, run.collected_from, run.collected_to, run.include_linked_announcements, run.maximum_count, run.scope_snapshot_at FROM announcement_source_reclassification_runs run WHERE run.id = #{runId} ), selected_sources AS ( SELECT snapshot.id AS source_id, content.id AS content_version_id, content.raw_hash AS content_hash, snapshot.classification_row_version, current_evaluation.id AS previous_evaluation_id, snapshot.semantic_status_code, snapshot.semantic_reason_code, snapshot.semantic_matched_keywords, snapshot.review_status_code FROM announcement_source_snapshots snapshot CROSS JOIN run_scope INNER JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT version.id, version.raw_hash FROM announcement_source_content_versions version WHERE version.source_id = snapshot.id ORDER BY version.collected_at DESC, version.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) content ON TRUE LEFT JOIN announcement_source_classification_evaluations current_evaluation ON current_evaluation.source_id = snapshot.id AND current_evaluation.is_current = TRUE WHERE snapshot.data_purpose_code = 'PRODUCTION' AND snapshot.collected_at <= run_scope.scope_snapshot_at AND (run_scope.provider_code IS NULL OR snapshot.provider_code = run_scope.provider_code) AND (run_scope.collected_from IS NULL OR snapshot.collected_at::date >= run_scope.collected_from) AND (run_scope.collected_to IS NULL OR snapshot.collected_at::date <= run_scope.collected_to) AND ( run_scope.include_linked_announcements OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM announcement_source_links source_link WHERE source_link.source_id = snapshot.id ) ) ORDER BY snapshot.collected_at ASC, snapshot.id ASC LIMIT (SELECT maximum_count FROM run_scope) ) INSERT INTO announcement_source_reclassification_run_items ( id, run_id, source_id, content_version_id, content_hash, expected_classification_version, previous_evaluation_id, previous_semantic_status_code, previous_semantic_reason_code, previous_semantic_matched_keywords, previous_review_status_code ) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), #{runId}, selected_sources.source_id, selected_sources.content_version_id, selected_sources.content_hash, selected_sources.classification_row_version, selected_sources.previous_evaluation_id, selected_sources.semantic_status_code, selected_sources.semantic_reason_code, selected_sources.semantic_matched_keywords, selected_sources.review_status_code FROM selected_sources
mapper.update: -- Record the immutable target count and complete an empty preview without worker activity. UPDATE announcement_source_reclassification_runs run SET total_count = target.total_count, run_status_code = CASE WHEN target.total_count = 0 THEN 'PREVIEW_COMPLETED' ELSE run_status_code END, preview_completed_at = CASE WHEN target.total_count = 0 THEN now() ELSE preview_completed_at END, updated_at = now(), row_version = row_version + 1 FROM ( SELECT count(1)::integer AS total_count FROM announcement_source_reclassification_run_items item WHERE item.run_id = #{runId} ) target WHERE run.id = #{runId}
mapper.select:
-- Select the oldest resumable worker run; the deployment uses one application instance. SELECT
FROM announcement_source_reclassification_runs run
WHERE run.run_status_code IN ( 'PREVIEW_PENDING', 'PREVIEW_RUNNING', 'APPLY_PENDING', 'APPLY_RUNNING', 'ROLLBACK_PENDING', 'ROLLBACK_RUNNING' ) ORDER BY run.created_at ASC, run.id ASC LIMIT 1

-- Select a deterministic bounded work batch for one run phase. SELECT item.id AS item_id, item.run_id, item.source_id, item.content_version_id, item.content_hash, item.expected_classification_version, item.previous_evaluation_id, item.previous_semantic_status_code, item.previous_semantic_reason_code, item.previous_semantic_matched_keywords, item.previous_review_status_code, item.predicted_semantic_status_code, item.predicted_reason_code, item.prediction_hash, item.item_status_code, item.applied_evaluation_id, item.applied_classification_version FROM announcement_source_reclassification_run_items item WHERE item.run_id = #{runId} AND item.item_status_code = #{itemStatusCode} ORDER BY item.source_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

-- Count redacted title-exclusion evidence that no longer has source content to restore. SELECT count(1)::integer FROM announcement_source_reclassification_run_items item WHERE item.run_id = #{runId} AND item.exclusion_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.update:
-- Perform an optimistic run transition and retain non-sensitive action reason hashes. UPDATE announcement_source_reclassification_runs SET run_status_code = #{nextStatusCode}, application_reason_hash = CASE WHEN #{nextStatusCode} IN ('APPLY_PENDING', 'APPLY_PAUSED') THEN coalesce(#{actionReasonHash}, application_reason_hash) ELSE application_reason_hash END, rollback_reason_hash = CASE WHEN #{nextStatusCode} = 'ROLLBACK_PENDING' THEN coalesce(#{actionReasonHash}, rollback_reason_hash) ELSE rollback_reason_hash END, preview_completed_at = CASE WHEN #{nextStatusCode} IN ('PREVIEW_COMPLETED', 'PREVIEW_PARTIAL_FAILED') THEN now() ELSE preview_completed_at END, application_started_at = CASE WHEN #{nextStatusCode} IN ('APPLY_PENDING', 'APPLY_RUNNING') THEN coalesce(application_started_at, now()) ELSE application_started_at END, application_completed_at = CASE WHEN #{nextStatusCode} IN ('APPLY_COMPLETED', 'APPLY_PARTIAL_FAILED') THEN now() ELSE application_completed_at END, rollback_started_at = CASE WHEN #{nextStatusCode} IN ('ROLLBACK_PENDING', 'ROLLBACK_RUNNING') THEN coalesce(rollback_started_at, now()) ELSE rollback_started_at END, rollback_completed_at = CASE WHEN #{nextStatusCode} IN ('ROLLBACK_COMPLETED', 'ROLLBACK_PARTIAL_FAILED') THEN now() ELSE rollback_completed_at END, row_version = row_version + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{runId} AND row_version = #{expectedVersion} AND run_status_code IN
#{statusCode}

-- Store a dry-run prediction without changing the source or current evaluation. UPDATE announcement_source_reclassification_run_items SET predicted_semantic_status_code = #{predictedSemanticStatusCode}, predicted_reason_code = #{predictedReasonCode}, prediction_hash = #{predictionHash}, item_status_code = 'PREVIEWED', error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL, previewed_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{itemId} AND item_status_code = 'PENDING'

-- Link one successful application to its append-only evaluation. UPDATE announcement_source_reclassification_run_items SET item_status_code = 'APPLIED', applied_evaluation_id = #{evaluationId}, applied_classification_version = #{appliedClassificationVersion}, error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL, applied_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{itemId} AND item_status_code = 'PREVIEWED'

-- Mark one applied item restored to its captured pre-run projection. UPDATE announcement_source_reclassification_run_items SET item_status_code = 'ROLLED_BACK', error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL, rolled_back_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{itemId} AND item_status_code = 'APPLIED'

-- Retain a bounded operational failure reason without raw source content. UPDATE announcement_source_reclassification_run_items SET item_status_code = #{nextStatusCode}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{itemId} AND item_status_code = #{expectedStatusCode}

-- Restore the captured compatibility projection using optimistic classification ownership. UPDATE announcement_source_snapshots SET semantic_status_code = #{semanticStatusCode}, semantic_reason_code = #{semanticReasonCode}, semantic_matched_keywords = #{semanticMatchedKeywords}, review_status_code = #{reviewStatusCode}, classification_row_version = classification_row_version + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{sourceId} AND classification_row_version = #{expectedVersion}
